🚀 Hunyuan3D-2-WinPortable | Batchfile
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide an easy-to-install and run portable application for generating 3D models and textures using Hunyuan3D on Windows, optimized for users with consumer-grade NVIDIA GPUs.
✨ Key Features: • Portable package for Hunyuan3D 2.0/2.1 on Windows • Optimized for consumer-grade GPUs (via mmgp integration) • Support for specific CUDA versions (12.6 and 12.9) • Clear instructions for setup and requirements • Optional Developer Mode for efficient model storage
📖 Summary: This repository provides a portable package for running Hunyuan3D 2.0 and 2.1 on Windows. It integrates optimizations for consumer-grade GPUs and offers versions compatible with specific CUDA toolkits, simplifying the setup for 3D generation tasks.
